svg.title: Isostasy and a raised beach
svg.desc: The weight of an ice sheet presses the crust down into the mantle; when the ice melts the sea floods the low coast and forms a beach, and as the crust slowly rebounds that beach is lifted above the present sea level as a raised beach.

g.text: an ice sheet covers the land
by the weight of the ice
at the sea level of the time
it lags behind the ice melt
the crust has risen back up
